title: The currentRefinedValues widget doesn't show multi level values for hierarchicalMenu refinements
body:
In the current implementation of the currentRefinedValues widget, when a sub level in a hierarchicalMenu is selected, only the deeper level is available & available in the currentRefinedValues state.

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/1101220/23456207/c2783eaa-fe72-11e6-8b05-19780e295ade.png)

```js
{
  type: "hierarchical",
  attributeName: "hierarchicalCategories.lvl0",
  name: "PlayStation 4",
  count: 7,
  cssClasses: Object
}
```

Would be useful to have the full path, as it's exposed in the [JS helper via the getHierarchicalFacetBreadcrumb method](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js#asking-for-the-current-breadcrumb)
